workarounds.symptom: CI fails: AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute '__module__'
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix CI AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute '__module__'. Target files: pyproject.toml. Fix CI AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute '__module__': - Pin transformers != 5.13.0 Fix #2487. This PR makes a minor update to the `pyproject.toml` file to address a compatibility issue with a specific version of the `transformers` library. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/smolagents/pull/2488)

workarounds.symptom: BUG: f-string escape error in ToolSerializer.dumps causes uninformative error message
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: correct f-string escaping in ToolSerializer.dumps error message. Target files: src/smolagents/serialization.py. `ToolSerializer.dumps()` line 429 uses double braces `{{e}}` in the f-string, producing a literal `{e}` instead of interpolating the exception. Line 292 in the same file has the correct single-brace form. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/smolagents/pull/2134)
